news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: Revenues exceed analysts expectations while EPS lags behind
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹64.30 (down from ₹85.61 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹110.7b (up 6.0% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹12.4b (down 25% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 11% (down from 16% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 2.4%. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 8.2%. Revenue is forecast to grow 12% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 11% growth forecast for the Auto Components industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 8% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 1% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹19.77 (vs ₹23.25 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹19.77 (down from ₹23.25 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹28.1b (up 9.9% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹3.82b (down 15% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 14% (down from 18% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue is forecast to grow 14% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 10% growth forecast for the Auto Components industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 11% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 1% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: Balkrishna Industries Limited Approves Board Appointments, Effective February 1, 2026
news.body: Balkrishna Industries Limited approved appointment of Mr. Natarajan Gnanaskandan Tanjore (DIN: 00013939) as an Independent Director of the Company for a term of 5 (five) consecutive years with effect from 1st February, 2026. The company also approved appointment of Mr. Ashok Saraf (DIN: 01627873) as a Non-Executive Non-Independent Director of the Company liable to retire by rotation, which appointment shall take effect from 1st February, 2026.
